tess_finance: FYI — Ticket #5482 from Acme: they say they wired €12,450 on 2026-02-11, but our bank statement shows 'INTL TRF CHG REF: 7723X' with no invoice or PO. Can finance match? :thinking:

ryan_support: Do we have the transaction date, amount, and beneficiary account?

tess_finance: Bank CSV from treasury — value date 11/02, amount 12,450.00 EUR, sender bank HSBC UK. Beneficiary name = 'Redwood Inference Ltd'. Bank reference field = '7723X'. The payer claims their internal note was 'INV2026-0421/PO-99' but the statement truncated it to 'INV2026'. I pasted the CSV snippet below:

```
value_date,amount,currency,beneficiary,sender_ref
2026-02-11,12450.00,EUR,Redwood Inference Ltd,7723X
```

devon_ops: We see truncation on SWIFT narratives a lot when intermediary banks are used. We need MT103 or originating bank advice to see the full payment narrative and trace id. Can support ask the customer for remittance?

tess_finance: I've contacted Acme. They sent a portal screenshot showing reference 'INV-2026-0421/PO-99' and an internal trace 'ACME-TR-8812'. They also provided the payer IBAN (partially masked).

ryan_support: OK — request: 'Please attach the MT103 / payment confirmation PDF and the originating bank trace. Confirm the sender account name & full IBAN used.' I'll send a templated note.

payments_bot: Payment alert: incoming EUR 12,450 credited 2026-02-11 to account ending ...4321. No remittance metadata parsed.

leah_sre: Also check fees — if intermediary banks took fees, amount could be off by a few euros which breaks auto-match. Can finance verify ledger entries for any bank charges?

tess_finance: Finance ledger shows full amount posted, no deduction on our side. But our reconciliation rules require invoice reference to auto-apply. Will do manual apply once we have MT103.

ryan_support: Drafting message to Acme now: 'Can you supply the MT103 or bank advice showing the full narrative and the exact sending account/IBAN? If possible, include any intermediary bank details.'

tess_finance: Also opening a bank query with treasury: request full transaction narrative and SWIFT trace. Can treasury escalate to get the ordering customer text?

devon_ops: Assigned FIN-REF-2026-0421 to Tess. Tagging @leah_sre to watch for audit logs in case we need to backfill metadata. :thumbsup:

tess_finance: Thanks — will update here once we receive MT103 or bank reply. :eyes:
